meta.title: Frankencoin security: audits, bug bounty and independent ratings
meta.description: Audits by ChainSecurity, Code4rena, Decurity and BlockBite, a bug bounty run by Compass Security, and independent risk ratings from Xerberus and Pharos.

hero.title: Audited, rated,|and open to anyone who finds a bug.
hero.subtitle: Each Frankencoin component is audited before launch, a bug bounty pays for responsible disclosure, and two independent providers rate the system from public data.
